    edge_colors = Counter()
    for x in g[0] + g[-1]:
        if x != bg: edge_colors[x] += 1
    for row in g:
        if row[0] != bg: edge_colors[row[0]] += 1
        if row[-1] != bg: edge_colors[row[-1]] += 1
    wall = edge_colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [x for x in counts if x not in (bg, wall)]
    if not colors:

    ink = colors[0]
    seeds = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == ink]
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    # Opposite colored edge segments determine the direction of the rays.
    left = [r for r in range(h) if g[r][0] == wall]
    right = [r for r in range(h) if g[r][-1] == wall]
    top = [c for c in range(w) if g[0][c] == wall]
    bottom = [c for c in range(w) if g[-1][c] == wall]
    def runs(vals):

        ans.append((a,b)); return ans

            side = next(((a,b,'L') for a,b in L if a <= r <= b), None)

                if other:
                    rr=other[0]+(r-a)
                    for cc in range(1,w-1): out[rr][cc]=ink
                for cc in range(1,c): out[r][cc]=ink
                out[r][c]=4
                continue
            side = next(((a,b,'R') for a,b in R if a <= r <= b), None)
            if side:
                a,b,_=side; other=next(((x,y) for x,y in L if y-x == b-a), None)
                if other:
                    rr=other[0]+(r-a)
                    for cc in range(1,w-1): out[rr][cc]=ink
                for cc in range(c+1,w-1): out[r][cc]=ink
                out[r][c]=4
    else:
        T,B = runs(top), runs(bottom)
        # The middle column(s) of the upper edge segment continue inward.
        for a,b in T:
            centers = list(range((a+b)//2, (a+b)//2+1)) if (b-a+1)%2 else [ (a+b)//2, (a+b)//2+1 ]
            for c in centers:
                for r in range(1,h-1): out[r][c]=ink
        for r,c in seeds:
            if any(a <= c <= b for a,b in B):
                for rr in range(r+1,h-1): out[rr][c]=ink
                out[r][c]=4
            elif any(a <= c <= b for a,b in T):
                for rr in range(1,r): out[rr][c]=ink
                out[r][c]=4
    return out
